A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 22-page MA-RAG paper, including readable figures, tables, equations, Appendices A–G, and prompt templates. Text and rendered pages 2–22 are identical; differences are confined to title-page authorship, affiliation, and date/version information.

before.justification: v1 reports original medical QA evaluations, component ablations, and scaling experiments in Section 4, with additional ranking and retrieval experiments in Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains those original benchmark evaluations, ablations, and supplementary experiments in Section 4 and Appendix F.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same solver, conflict-guided retrieval, ranking, stopping, and answer-selection procedures. Scoring variants and the evaluator training objective are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain MedQA, MedMCQA, MedBullets, medical MMLU-Pro, NEJM, English MedExpQA, and text MedXpertQA. The MedCorp retrieval corpus and evaluator-training sources are unchanged (Appendices B, D–E).

E2.justification: The same 12 baselines appear in Table 1, including CoT, SC, Multi-Refine, SR-RAG, FL-RAG, FS-RAG, FLARE, and TC-RAG. Appendix F retains the same Best-of-N and Oracle comparisons.

E3.justification: Data splits, accuracy and Recall@k metrics, backbone sizes, candidate/refinement settings, retrieval budgets, and controlled experimental configurations match throughout Section 4 and Appendices B–F.

E4.justification: Component ablations, round/candidate/query-count sensitivity studies, model-scaling analyses, static reranking comparisons, retrieval compatibility tests, and hybrid/oracle ranking analyses are identical (Sections 4.2–4.4 and Appendix F).

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version reports evaluation seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, standard errors, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and reported findings match, including supplementary results. For example, Table 1 retains average accuracies of 55.4% for Qwen3-8B, 61.0% for MA-RAG-int, and 62.2% for MA-RAG-ext.

T1.justification: The state definitions, ranking scores, training loss, and self-consistency formulation in Equations (1)–(8) are identical. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added, removed, or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same conflict-guided multi-round reasoning contribution, test-time scaling claims, and claimed 6.8-point average accuracy improvement over the backbone.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning knowledge-gap resolution, context ranking, scaling, and verifier quality are unchanged. Sections 5–6 and Appendix G retain the same limitations concerning inference cost, corpus coverage and quality, imperfect verification, and residual hallucinations.

D1.justification: Appendices D–E and the prompt templates retain identical retrieval settings, data-generation procedures, evaluator architecture, and training hyperparameters. The code-access link is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, cited works, and the reference list are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to adaptive RAG, self-consistency, iterative refinement, and classical boosting.

P1.justification: v2 removes Zhenhong Sun and the Australian National University affiliation, changes the preprint date from March 5 to March 25, 2026, and updates the arXiv marker. Scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The shortened author row is recentered and the affiliation footnote rewraps on page 1. All figures, tables, captions, and remaining page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revision changes only title-page authorship, affiliation, and date/version information, with minor reflow. Scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility material—including all appendices—are identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
